description: The channel follows Porter, an angler based in Arizona, as he sets out to catch as many different fish species as possible in various local waters. The videos typically feature him taking on self-imposed fishing challenges, such as trying to catch every species found around Phoenix in just a few days, while exploring ponds, canals, and rivers. Beyond the species-hunting missions, the content also captures unexpected moments, like when he reeled in a surprising non-fish item from an Arizona river.
